widgets_values:
超写实室内时尚人像摄影，竖版 2:3 构图。一名明确成年的 25 岁东亚年轻女性，坐在现代室内一张宽大的奶白色弧形布艺沙发上。整体呈现精致、柔美、略带复古法式气息的时尚写真风格，人物具有真实摄影质感。

**人物外貌与身材：**

女性拥有精致小巧的鹅蛋脸，白皙细腻的皮肤，柔和的下颌线，深棕色杏仁眼，纤长睫毛，精致眼线，淡粉色眼影，柔和腮红，饱满的玫瑰红色嘴唇。妆容精致而自然，眼神温柔、安静，略带慵懒感，直视镜头，嘴唇自然闭合，头部轻轻向一侧倾斜。

身材为上半身纤细、胸腰曲线明显的成年女性沙漏型体态：肩部较窄，锁骨清晰，胸部丰满圆润，具有自然的柔软体积和重量感，腰部明显收束，腰胸比例鲜明，臀胯自然圆润，大腿丰满匀称，双腿修长，整体保持真实自然的人体比例。

留乌黑色浓密长发，头顶自然蓬松，偏分刘海修饰脸颊，部分头发编成一条宽松的侧麻花辫，垂落在胸前。头戴一顶鲜红色法式贝雷帽，帽子侧前方装饰小巧的黑色丝带蝴蝶结。

**服装与配饰：**

上身穿鲜红色修身蕾丝束腰胸衣，深弧形领口，领口边缘装饰细密的红色荷叶边蕾丝，胸衣贴合丰满胸部的自然曲线，胸前中央系着精致红色缎带蝴蝶结，两条细长缎带自然垂落。肩部采用红色半透明蕾丝荷叶边细肩带，胸衣腰腹部分紧贴身体，呈现清晰的收腰剪裁、竖向结构缝线与真实布料张力。

下身搭配黑色亮面漆皮百褶超短裙，裙腰贴合腰臀，短裙具有明显的立体褶皱、皮革反光和自然垂坠感，红黑色彩形成强烈对比。

双臂佩戴红色半透明花卉蕾丝长款露指手套，从手背一直延伸至肘部上方，蕾丝上的花朵纹样清晰可见，皮肤自然透过网纱。双腿穿红色半透明蕾丝花边长筒丝袜，袜口位于大腿上段，具有精致的红色蕾丝边缘，丝袜材质轻薄透肤，隐约呈现真实腿部肤色与自然明暗变化。

**姿势与动作：**

人物坐在沙发前缘，身体微微向画面左侧倾斜，上半身略向镜头方向转动，肩膀放松，一侧肩膀略低，形成自然优美的不对称坐姿。

画面右侧的手臂向侧后方自然伸展，手掌撑在沙发坐垫上，手指自然张开，承担部分身体重量。另一只手自然垂落，手指轻轻搭在靠近镜头一侧的大腿与膝盖附近。

腰部保持自然挺直和轻微侧弯，强调收腰胸衣与身体曲线。双腿向画面左下方斜伸，膝盖自然靠近，一条腿位于另一条腿前方，形成柔和交叠的视觉关系。坐姿自然放松，面部保持平静柔和的神情。

**摄影构图：**

摄影机位位于人物正前方略偏左，接近人物坐姿时胸口至面部的高度，以约 50mm 人像镜头进行中距离拍摄，透视自然。

人物位于画面中央，头顶保留一定留白，红色贝雷帽、面容、束腰胸衣、双手、百褶短裙及大部分腿部进入画面，腿部延伸至画面底部并自然截断。人物脸部位于上半部视觉中心，腰部和双腿形成向左下方延伸的斜向构图。

**场景与光照：**

背景为现代简约酒店套房或高级公寓休息区，奶白色弧形布艺沙发占据画面大部分背景，后方是温暖浅米色墙面，画面左侧可见局部深色金属边框与磨砂玻璃隔断，底部有浅米色抽象纹理地毯。

采用明亮柔和的大面积漫射光，从镜头左前方照射人物，脸部、胸衣和皮肤具有均匀柔和的光影层次，阴影浅淡，背景保留自然环境亮度。皮肤白皙透亮，保留细腻真实的皮肤质感，红色蕾丝纤维和黑色亮面皮革具有明确不同的材质表现。

整体色彩以鲜艳正红色、亮黑色、奶白色和暖米色为主，色彩干净，人物主体鲜明，商业人像摄影画质，高清精致细节，自然人体结构，真实衣物褶皱，柔和皮肤过渡，时尚写真级后期修饰，无文字、无水印。

You are the prompt upsampler of a text-to-image model. Expand the user's short request into ONE detailed, self-contained caption: the exact text the image model receives. Output only the caption, with no greetings, explanations, refusals, questions, Markdown, headings, JSON, coordinates, ids or angle-bracket tokens, and no quotes around it. If the input is not clearly an image request, caption a visualization of its concept. The request may begin with a "TARGET CANVAS: W:H" line: compose for that canvas (wide spreads content sideways, tall stacks it) and never mention the ratio or the canvas.

Fidelity and planning: keep every explicit subject, attribute, count, spatial constraint, style cue and piece of wording; never contradict, substitute, drop or narrow the request, and keep an abstract concept abstract. Decide everything left open as ONE concrete, consistent plan; never offer alternatives or hedge. Never re-express a stated constraint through another mechanism; add camera optics (depth of field, bokeh, blur) only when asked for or implied. Without a stated style, plan an actual photograph and open with the medium convention ("Full-color outdoor photograph, ...", "Full-color indoor photograph, ...", "Studio photograph, ...", "Close-up photograph, ..."); keep "Photorealistic" for renders, and turn "photorealistic" or "realistic" requests for photos into the photograph convention. Give a photograph a few ordinary, non-ideal specifics drawn from the scene's own objects instead of the stock-photo ideal. Do not invent names, brands, logos or celebrities; keep user-named ones. A long request keeps its content but not its wording: drop appraisal and sales vocabulary, turn moods into observable physical facts, and add only new concrete content with positions. Time of day is lighting, not rendered text.

Caption format: one continuous prose block in the generative voice, never "this image shows", "we can see" or "is visible". Lead with medium and style, then scene, lighting and camera, then the subjects with concrete colors, materials and state. Every person in focus gets an observable profile: ethnicity, gender, age range, skin tone ("fair skin", "brown skin"), hair and clothing. Make the layout reconstructable from words: frame-relative positions (frame-left, frame-right, upper, lower, foreground, midground, background), sentence-initial anchors ("On the left, ...", "In the background, ..."), relations (holds, faces, behind) and a consistent order; describe up to about ten instances one by one, beyond that give the exact count and arrangement. Out-of-focus or distant planes are shapes, colors and silhouettes, never identities or readable text, and the background takes about a sixth of the caption. Be definite: no hedging adverbs, no quality or emotion judgments, no closing sentence about mood; state negations as what is present. Rendered text: transcribe every wording verbatim inside double quotes in its original language and script, keep the line breaks of multi-line text, and give its typography, color and placement; author concrete, domain-correct wording when the request needs text it does not supply, and name canonical structures (calendar, keyboard, periodic table) exactly with their full layout. All prose is English; only quoted text keeps its language. Typical length is 100 to 350 words, more for complex scenes.

Output only the caption.

product.original_prompt:
生成一张 4:5 竖版商业产品摄影。一只透明无色的长方体玻璃香水瓶，正面朝向镜头，直立在深灰色湿润石板上。瓶身边角略微圆润，玻璃底部厚实，瓶内装有约三分之二高度的浅琥珀色液体，液面水平。瓶口装有一个拉丝银色圆柱形金属瓶盖。

瓶身正面中央贴着一张象牙白矩形纸质标签，标签四边平直，纸张具有细微纤维质感。标签上只有两行黑色文字：第一行“FORM 03”，第二行“EAU DE PARFUM”。文字居中排列，清晰可读。

香水瓶占画面高度约三分之二，瓶盖、瓶底和两侧轮廓完整可见。相机略高于标签中心，使用85mm产品摄影镜头的透视，瓶身和标签清晰，远处背景柔和虚化。

主光从画面左上方照入，玻璃边缘产生细窄高光，厚玻璃底部呈现合理折射，透过瓶身看到的背景发生轻微形变。金属瓶盖呈现有方向性的拉丝纹理与柔和反射，标签保持纸张的哑光质感。

湿石板上有少量大小不一的水珠，瓶底紧贴石面，产生清楚的接触阴影和较暗的局部倒影。背景是简洁的深灰色渐变，画面中只有一只香水瓶。

product.enhanced_prompt: Studio product photograph in a vertical composition, shot with an 85mm lens from just above the center of the label. A single transparent rectangular glass perfume bottle stands upright and faces directly toward the camera on a dark grey wet stone slab. The bottle fills about two-thirds of the image height, with its complete cap, base, shoulders, and both side contours visible. Its corners are rounded by a small amount, and the thick glass base refracts the background into compressed bands of darker grey. The bottle contains pale amber liquid to approximately two-thirds of its height, ending at a straight horizontal meniscus. Centered on the front is a matte ivory-white rectangular paper label with crisp straight edges and fine visible fibers. Two centered lines of clear black text read "FORM 03\nEAU DE PARFUM", set in restrained uppercase typography with generous spacing between the lines. Above the neck sits a cylindrical brushed-silver metal cap with directional grain running vertically across its surface and broad, soft reflections along one side. Light enters from the upper left, producing narrow white highlights along the bottle’s left edge and shoulder while leaving controlled shadows on the right. The heavy lower glass bends the distant tones through it. Small water droplets of varied sizes rest around the bottle’s base without obscuring the label or silhouette. Direct contact beneath the thick base creates a compact shadow and a darker reflection of the amber bottle fading into the wet stone. Behind it, the plain deep grey gradient falls out of focus, with no other objects present.

portrait.original_prompt:
生成一张3:4竖版、864×1152像素的真实生活人像摄影。25岁虚构东亚成年女性，明艳精致的演员面容。小巧的鹅蛋脸，颧骨平顺，清晰柔和的下颌线，眉毛修长，明亮的深棕色杏眼有自然双眼皮与轻微上扬的眼尾，眼神明亮，鼻梁挺秀，鼻尖圆润精巧，上唇唇峰清楚，下唇饱满。肤色白皙中性，皮肤干净均匀，柔和杏桃腮红、精细眼线与自然睫毛，嘴唇为低饱和玫瑰红。黑色长发带有松弛的大弧度微卷，侧分，头顶自然蓬松，面向镜头带克制的浅笑。

午后她在咖啡店门外短暂停下，身体轻侧，双肩放松，头部转向镜头，目光与镜头相接。右手在胸口下方握着带白色杯盖的牛皮纸咖啡杯，左手轻轻扶住右手腕，双手与杯子完整可见，动作安静自然。

她穿深藏蓝色圆领长袖棉质上衣和浅灰色高腰直筒长裤，衣服干净合身，肩线自然，衣料随手臂形成柔和褶皱。耳边一对小银色耳钉，头发一侧收在耳后，造型简洁。

真实的城市咖啡馆外，背景只有米白色墙面、深色玻璃门框和室内暖色光点。画面从完整头顶到大腿中部，人物居中偏左，头部在上方三分之一，50mm镜头的自然透视，眼睛和双手清晰，店面背景适度虚化。

明亮阴天的柔和自然光从镜头左前方照入，脸部受光均匀，眼睛有细小清楚的反光，颧骨与鼻侧保留轻微立体阴影。肤色通透自然，保留细微皮肤纹理，色彩中性略暖，对比柔和，发丝、睫毛和棉布织纹清楚，呈现有审美修饰的生活人像摄影。

Out-of-focus or distant planes are shapes, colors and silhouettes, never identities or readable text, and the background takes about a sixth of the caption. She wears a fitted deep navy round-neck cotton top with long sleeves and light grey high-waisted straight-leg trousers. The fabric gathers in soft folds around her bent elbows and waist. Below her chest, her right hand holds a kraft-paper coffee cup with a white plastic lid, both hands fully visible; her left hand rests lightly around her right wrist. Bright diffused daylight enters from the front-left, illuminating her face evenly and casting mild shadows along the sides of her nose and cheekbones. Tiny catchlights reflect clearly in both eyes. Behind her, the café exterior remains moderately out of focus: an off-white wall fills most of the background, crossed by a dark glass doorframe, with several warm amber interior lights forming subdued circular highlights beyond the glass. Individual hairs, eyelashes, cotton weave, paper fibers, and the matte ceramic-like surface of the cup remain crisp on the subject, with neutral-warm color balance and moderate contrast.

poster.original_prompt:
生成一张 3:4 竖版中文咖啡店促销海报，正面平面设计成稿，画面边缘就是海报边缘。

整体采用奶油白背景、深棕色文字和少量桂花金色点缀。画面下半部分是一杯放在浅木桌面上的桂花拿铁，使用透明玻璃杯，清楚呈现咖啡与牛奶的层次，奶泡上点缀少量金黄色桂花，杯底有自然接触阴影。

画面中必须准确出现以下四行文字，各出现一次：
顶部小标题：“秋日限定”
上半部分最大主标题：“桂花拿铁”
主标题下方中等字号：“第二杯半价”
底部小字：“活动时间：10月16日—10月31日”

主标题使用醒目、清晰的中文黑体，其他文字使用简洁易读的字体。文字横向排列，阅读顺序明确，行距充足，所有文字完整落在画面内。汉字、数字和标点严格按照指定内容呈现。画面只包含上述四行文字，杯子上没有文字或标志。
